notes: Run your own pool (doc 51 v1.0 §3). BTC only. Real pools fee rows live in custody.json (see custody_additions.json). Costs and probabilities are designed [D] unless graded otherwise.

ddos_protection.before: doc 57: protection for raw TCP cost $3,000-7,000 a month in 2011-12 (enterprise only), so a hobby pool had none

PPS.reserve_rule: PPS can be chosen only while cash covers 3 x sqrt(expected pool blocks per week) block rewards; below 0 cash under PPS, 50% of outside miners leave each week and reputation -30

outside_miners.model: outside hashrate = network hashrate x small_pool_share[year] x pull; pull starts at start_pull and moves each quarter with fee, luck and reputation, minus churn

2011.source: doc 55 §4: solo mining dominant, Deepbit majority

2013.source: doc 55 §4: outside the top five (Cong, He and Li 2018 [B]) minus solo

start_pull.source: a new pool gets 0.25% of the small-pool market (M71.7 lever (a): was 0.005; doc 51 §13 decision 1)

fee_elasticity_per_pp.source: doc 53 B3: -8% hashrate per +1 pp fee against the median (M71.7 lever (b), -0.12, tried and reverted: it widened X-B2 from 8.54x to 9.04x)

median_fee_by_year.source: size-weighted average pool fee, Cong, He and Li 2018 (doc 55 §4); used as the market fee the player is compared with

bad_luck_spiral.value: after 3 unlucky weeks in a row under PPLNS, -15% outside hashrate each further unlucky week

reputation.up: +5 a quarter with no outage or theft

ddos.source: small pools were hit far less than big ones: 7 of 41 small pools over May 2011-Oct 2013 (Vasek, Thornton, Moore, FC 2014 [A]); about 3% a quarter

hot_wallet_theft.source: real cases: 3,094 BTC on 1 Mar 2012 and 923 BTC on 19 Apr 2013 [B]

theft_size.value: one week of outside miners payouts; under PPS the operator still owes them

boycott_2014.condition: pool open, fee at or below the median, reputation >= 50

small_pool_share_bump_pp_by_week.source: doc 57: GHash.io 55% on 12-13 Jun, 42% on 15 Jun, 35% on 19 Jun, about 34.6% in mid-July [B]; most of the outflow went to big pools; linear between the points

lasting_bump_pp.source: after week 8, to the end of 2014; then the yearly share table takes over

boycott_2014.replaces: the v1.0 x1.3 for two quarters

sale.price: trailing four quarters of fee income x multiple
sale.at_handover: an open pool is sold automatically at this price (owner, doc 51 §8)

names.note: invented; OreLoop renamed Slagwheel (doc 57: a Swedish gold-mining technology company uses OreLoop); formal USPTO and EUIPO searches before ship
